note: Analysis of SAP v1 (docs/protocol/sap_v1.md, decided 2026-11-12) on a per-cuff feature table (docs/data_convention.md section 4.6). Every key cites its SAP section. Feature columns, PAT pairing and window are locked on the pilot (SAP 4); the column names here are those of software/device/features.py. Proposed 2026-11-13, pending review; the bootstrap seed and delta are fixed in the SAP locking commit and after the pilot. The SAP locking commit sets status to LOCKED; scripts/run_rq1_analysis.py refuses non-SYNTHETIC data under any other status (added 2026-11-13, pending review).

ridge.sap: section 4: Ridge, alpha = 1 fixed, no intercept, columns divided by their SD over the training cuffs, weight 1 / cuffs of the subject

ppg.sap: section 4: PPG-only (rise time, width at 50 %, amplitude, HR from PPG)

ablation_ecg.sap: section 3 endpoint 4: PPG + PAT + HR/HRV from ECG; HRV as RMSSD is a proposal (SAP does not name the HRV index)

phase_ppg.sap: section 3 endpoint 10 and section 4: M1, M2, session >= 2 indicators

comparison.sap: section 3: d = MAE_s(PPG+PAT) - MAE_s(PPG-only), d0 against zero-change, dP against the phase mean

bootstrap.sap: section 5: 10 000 subject draws; the seed is a proposal until the SAP locking commit

ci_method_sap: section 5: envelope of bootstrap-t and Student t; sensitivity CIs percentile, BCa, bootstrap-t, Student t
holm_sap: section 6 option A: 97.5 % for both outcomes, then 95 % for the other when exactly one passes
delta_sap: section 8: delta fixed after the pilot; null gives the reading delta_not_set
sqi_exclusion_sap: section 3 endpoint 5, SQI v1 section 5 (thresholds locked on G2)
